STEP 1 - Scene: A mixed green side salad (mixed leaves with shredded carrot, some dark leaves, a few nuts/seeds or croutons), with a small piece of what looks like pizza or a baked item with tomato sauce at the top edge. Most of the meal appears to have been eaten, leaving a salad pile.

- Mixed leaves (green and red-purple lettuce/spinach)
- Shredded carrot
- Small nuts/almond slivers and a few dark bits (possibly dried fruit or nuts)

- Mixed leaves: ~20% (106 cm^2)

- Nuts/dried fruit: 5 cm^2 x 0.8 cm ≈ 4 ml

- Leaves: 40 g x 20 kcal/100g = 8 kcal
- Carrot: 3 g x 40 kcal/100g ≈ 1 kcal
- Nuts/dried fruit: 2 g x 500 kcal/100g = 10 kcal
- Pizza sliver: 8 g x 270 kcal/100g ≈ 22 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 53 g and ≈ 41 kcal. This fits a mostly eaten salad with only a small remaining pile and a sliver of pizza. Dressing is not clearly visible, so it is not added, though a small dressing amount could add 10–30 kcal.
